contract: track_started {libraryItemId, ino} goes to admin sockets only (SocketAuthority.adminEmitter). The encode job fires it from the TrackProgressMonitor construction and on every mid-merge track boundary (AbMergeManager.js:143-151, TrackProgressMonitor.js:27-87); the embed job fires it once per audio file just before that file is tagged (AudioMetadataManager.js:204-209). A refused admission produces none; a failing file still reports its started event.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.
Source-confirmed missing producer candidate in tools: literal search alone does not prove absence; characterize source/client lifecycle before implementation.
force is not applicable: no force or override input exists for these events; the only tools option, forceEmbedChapters, changes only the task document's chapters, not the track or progress events.

invariants.contract: track_started payload and recipients: one argument object with the string libraryItemId and ino, delivered to admin sockets only, one per tagged file in task order for embeds and one per merged track for encodes.
